text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: —Apparently, they call it "The Wicked in the White Coat."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Running rampant through the academy day and night, kidnapping students to another world to use as experimental subjects—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: More and more students are growing anxious. If only we could find the cause somehow...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A strange rumor troubling the academy lately. After consulting with Tazuna-san who was worried about the students, I volunteered to patrol the campus—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (RUMBLE RUMBLE RUMBLE RUMBLE—!)
Whoa there, you over there~! Would you mind stopping me—
Wait, impossible, right?! Ahahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Tch, the hell is that speed?! There ain't anything like that in the data!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Um... Did you happen to see... which way Tachyon-san went...?
choice_data_list: Was that Agnes Tachyon just now?!
Was that Agnes Tachyon just now?!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Yes... It seems she... used herself as a test subject... once again...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Oi, this ain't the time to stand around chatting, is it? I'm heading ahead!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To uncover the truth behind the rumor, I decided to chase after Agnes Tachyon as well.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: —Found her, it's Tachyon!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: It's dangerous... Please... watch from right there...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Pursued by Air Shakur and the others, Agnes Tachyon sprinted ahead while laughing heartily. Yet for some reason, she looked remarkably free—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*...
Damn it, what a pain in the ass...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Aha, ha... haha! Well now—*cough* *cough*, I've finally managed to stop!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Well, you see, as usual, I was trying out a new experimental device, but—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmm, choosing the form factor of a supporter was indeed the right choice. Good fit, no hindrance to range of motion—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Now then, let us immediately test run it outside... —Mmhm?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: To my surprise, once this device starts running, it cannot stop, nor can I even decide my destination. Thus, for the past few days, I found myself running non-stop before I realized it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Thanks to our game of tag, the power seems to have finally run out. Well now, haha, you have my immense gratitude!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...This is no laughing matter...
Tachyon-san... How is your physical condition...?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Besides, why the hell did you make a gadget like that when it can't even be used in a race?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Because I wanted to experience "dreams" and "aspirations" for myself at least once, of course~.

text_block_list.name: シャカール＆カフェ
text_block_list.text: Hah...? / What...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: In other words: my hypothesis is that factors such as "dreams" and "aspirations" possess the power to make horse girls exceed their limits.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Wanting to catch up to someone. Wanting to reach the pinnacle. Such egoistic desires—yet how profoundly have they pushed the backs of horse girls!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: However, looking within myself, I somehow don't possess what others call "dreams" or "aspirations." And so—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: To heighten the resolution of my understanding of motivation, I thought I'd take a shortcut and simulate the state of having achieved a "dream" or "aspiration"!

text_block_list.name: マンハッタンカフェ
text_block_list.text:
想いの力を……知りたい……。
それは……理解できますが……。
choice_data_list: だったら、君にその装置は必要なかったな
だったら、貴方にその装置は必要なかったね

text_block_list.name: モノローグ
text_block_list.text:
自分が実験台になってまで限界を超えたい。
それほどの強い『想い』を、すでに
アグネスタキオンは持っているのだから。

text_block_list.name: アグネスタキオン
text_block_list.text:
ンン……？　いやしかし、
私の野望とウマ娘の『夢』とでは
欲望の種類が違うような――

text_block_list.name: モノローグ
text_block_list.text: （ぐぅうう～～～）

text_block_list.name: アグネスタキオン
text_block_list.text: あ、あれ……？　なんだか眩暈が……。

text_block_list.name: エアシャカール
text_block_list.text:
チッ。飲まず食わずで走り回ってりゃ当然だ。
これに懲りたら、
怪しい実験はやめにしとくンだな。

text_block_list.name: アグネスタキオン
text_block_list.text: まさか！　実験をやめるなんてとんでもない！

text_block_list.name: アグネスタキオン
text_block_list.text:
走っていて、何か掴めそうに感じたんだよ！
出力の調整と、発動タイミングの調整。
それさえ達成できれば、また――

text_block_list.name: エアシャカール
text_block_list.text:
オイ、その前にメシ――って、ダメだ。
聞いてねェ……。

text_block_list.name: マンハッタンカフェ
text_block_list.text:
こうなると……手がつけられません……。
せめて……私たちが、見張る……べきかと。

text_block_list.name: モノローグ
text_block_list.text:
あきれつつも無理には研究を止めない2人。
アグネスタキオンの『想い』を応援したい。
そんな2人の気持ちを垣間見た1日だった。

text_block_list.name: アグネスタキオン
text_block_list.text:
気持ちよく走っている間に、
新しいアイディアを思いついたんだ！

text_block_list.name: アグネスタキオン
text_block_list.text:
親しい相手から逃げ回るという、
先ほどの状態を参考にした新しい装置をね！
ついては、君たち2人には今後も協力を――

text_block_list.name: シャカール＆カフェ
text_block_list.text:
断る。
……お断りします……。

text_block_list.name: モノローグ
text_block_list.text:
一向に懲りないアグネスタキオンに、
あきれ顔になる2人なのだった。
